summary: Privacy-focused AI answer engine you run on your own machine, searching the web with local or cloud models.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Vane is a privacy-focused AI answering engine that runs on your own hardware. It searches the internet through a bundled SearxNG engine and answers with local LLMs via Ollama or cloud providers like OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini and Groq.
sixtySeconds.problem: AI search services see every question you ask. Vane gives you an AI answer engine you host yourself.
whoFor: People who want AI search with local models
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a one-command Docker install with search built in, several search modes, source selection and helpful widgets.
requirements: Ollama or a cloud provider API key

overview: Run the Docker image, which includes Vane and SearxNG, then open http://localhost:3000 and enter your settings (API keys, models) in the setup screen.
Choose Speed, Balanced or Quality mode, and search the web, discussions or academic papers. Widgets show things like weather, calculations and stock prices.
You can also build from source with Docker or install without Docker. Vane is MIT licensed.
limitations: Answer quality depends on your model
